lines.en: I move slower than your breathing.

lines.zh: 我的影子比你整个人宽
lines.en: My shadow is wider than you are.
I walk closer out of the view.
My steps grow louder.
I step around the debris.
I hold a hand out ahead.
I approach and pause.
I move along the baseboard.
I lean further your way.
I turn slowly in front of you.
My body blocks the light.
I keep walking toward you.
I stop one block from you.
I lower my hand slowly.
My face is in your line of sight.
I stand behind you, motionless.
My mouth slowly stretches.
My chest doesn't move at all.
Caught; you won't move again.
I watch you without blinking.
I cock my head slightly.
I wait for you to back away.
I lower my body a little.
I shift half a block forward.
My colours darken.
I stop dead in front of you.
There is only black inside my sockets.
Close enough to see up my nose.
My hand is longer than your face.
My hand stops at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的嘴咧到了耳朵下面
lines.en: My mouth splits down past my ears.
You know this face.
I bring my face up to yours.

lines.zh: 抓住你的这一刻，嘴张到极限。
lines.en: At the catch, my mouth opens to its limit.
Do not be in a hurry to run.

lines.zh: 在你关门之前我还有时间
lines.en: I have time before you shut the door.

lines.zh: 我的指尖搭在你衣服上
lines.en: My fingertips rest on your clothes.
Your neck is twitching faintly.
I bare my teeth without sound.
I've caught you. Don't struggle.
The lamp lights me, but I cast no shadow.
I bring my face closer.
You could try shouting.
No one can hear you here.
You are not in my eyes.
My eyes are pinned on you.
My grip loosens a little.
My retreat looks like a grin.
My smile has not changed.
I give out no sound.
I lean back in slowly.
My outline shivers.
I straighten my head.
I am still in your way.
My hand rises again.
This body flickers solid and not.
What would you trade for this?
Caught by me, you won't run.
I flick it to the floor and leave it.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西我不喜欢
lines.en: I don't like what you're holding up.
That will not save you.
I cannot help laughing.
Push it back in. Don't let it spill.
Whatever you offer, I won't eat it.
I can watch you finish it.
I will wait until you finish trying.
You bump me and I withdraw half a block.
I walk slowly back.
My palm presses your shoulder.
You pass straight through me.
I felt no pain whatsoever.
I stand steadier than you.
You're already in my hands.

lines.zh: 你撞上了我伸出的手臂
lines.en: You ran into my outstretched arm.
I press a little closer.

lines.zh: 你无处可退了，我掌心贴住你的肩。
lines.en: Nowhere left to go — my palm is on your shoulder.
Another watches from the wall.
We surround you together.
It is closer than I.
Both our heads tip over.
Our shadows ring you.
We open our mouths together.
Not one word between us.
It reaches for you first.
I reach out too.
There is no room left for you.
I pinch it up.
I turn it between my fingers.
What I dropped is still rolling.
It cools in my hand.
I stare at it.
I hand it back to you.
You do not take it.
I press it into your hand.
I open my hand and let it fall.
I do not look at it again.

lines.zh: 我把歪脸摆正了对准你
lines.en: I straighten my face at you.
I stop moving slowly.
I am already in front of you.
Close enough to grab you in one step.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候没有声音
lines.en: My hand rises without a sound.
You cannot retreat any further.
I drop my shoulder.
The corners of my mouth split wider.
I am ready to take you.
One look at me is enough.
I come half a block closer.
My knee moved first.
Your back is against the wall.
I will not flicker this time.
I have finished counting.
I've sealed your way out.
I stay right against you.
One step back, one block in.

lines.zh: 我举着的手一直没有放下
lines.en: My raised hand has never come down.
I hear your breathing clearly.

lines.zh: 我在等你的膝盖弯下去
lines.en: I'm waiting for your knees to buckle.
I have you cornered.
No hurry; you cannot run.
Each time I am closer.
Your eyes are searching for a way.
I have blocked that way.

lines.zh: 你能退的地方越来越少
lines.en: Your room to retreat shrinks.
I raise my other hand slowly.
My face is right beside yours.
My steps stop behind your door.
I do not need to run.
I only need to walk forward.

lines.zh: 你抖得连脚步声都乱了
lines.en: Your shaking ruins even your footsteps.
I rest a hand on your shoulder.
I lean my body in.
One more step and you hit the wall.
I seize your shoulder.
My grip closes tight.

lines.zh: 我的指甲陷进你的衣领
lines.en: My nails sink into your collar.

lines.zh: 第二只手抓住了你的腰
lines.en: My second hand takes your waist.
My face comes up to yours.
You push and cannot move me.
I lift you off your feet.
My nails sink into cloth.
You struggle in my grip.
I turn you around.
You hear your own heartbeat.
I push you toward the wall.
My laugh is at your ear.
You kick me.
I do not let go.
I set you down a little.
I appear behind you.
My hand comes out first.
Even the wind stopped when I arrived.

lines.zh: 门在我背后，钥匙在地上。
lines.en: The door is behind me; the key is on the floor.
I step out of the wall.
My shadow reaches your feet first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处先睁开了
lines.en: My eyes opened first in the dark.
You have seen this face.
I walk slowly toward you.
I rise from the corner, very tall.
I raise my hand before your eyes.
Have you seen clearly?
I am not moving now.
You are not moving either.
I bring my head closer.
I grin.

lines.zh: 这里只有你和我，门锁上了。
lines.en: Just you and me, and the door's locked.
I do not mean to let you leave.
The first thing that moved was my mouth.
I begin to tighten my grip.
The firelight fades me a shade.
I took you down with me.
Water pours in and drains right out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我们两个都掀开
lines.en: The blast throws us both apart.
The arrow passes out through my shoulder.
Spell light tears at my hand.
I never eat; I only fade.
Lightning lights us both up.
The dark swallows us both.
